title: Floral Wrap Midi Dress with Flutter Sleeves and Tie Waist
description:
A breezy wrap dress in a soft floral print that ties at the waist for an adjustable, flattering fit. Dress it up with sandals or down with trainers on warm days.
• Material: 100% viscose, lightweight and fluid
• V-neckline, short flutter sleeves and a side slit in the midi skirt
• Self-tie waist; length approx. 115 cm in size M
• Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle, hang to dry

title: Ditsy Floral Sleeveless Sundress with Smocked Back
description:
A relaxed summer sundress covered in a small all-over floral print, with a stretchy smocked back panel that moves with you.
• Material: 100% cotton poplin
• Square neckline, wide shoulder straps and a flared knee-length skirt
• Two side seam pockets
• Length approx. 98 cm in size M
• Machine wash at 30°C

title: White Cotton Tiered Maxi Dress with Square Neck
description:
An airy tiered maxi dress in crisp white cotton, cut loose through the body for comfort on hot days, beach holidays and garden parties.
• Material: 100% cotton with a lined bodice
• Square neckline and short puff sleeves with elastic cuffs
• Three gathered tiers to the ankle, approx. 135 cm long in size M
• Machine wash at 30°C, iron on medium heat

title: Classic Cotton Poplin Button-Up Shirt, Relaxed Fit
description:
A wardrobe staple: a crisp button-up shirt with a slightly relaxed cut that works tucked into trousers or worn open over a tee.
• Material: 100% cotton poplin, non-stretch
• Pointed collar, front button placket and single-button cuffs
• Curved hem, slightly longer at the back
• Available in white and light blue
• Machine wash at 40°C

title: Satin Long Sleeve Blouse with Button Front
description:
A smooth satin blouse with a soft sheen that takes you from the office to dinner. The loose fit drapes nicely over trousers and skirts.
• Material: 100% polyester satin with a silky hand feel
• Notched collar, button front and buttoned cuffs
• Relaxed fit with dropped shoulders
• Colours: red, emerald and black
• Gentle machine wash cold; iron on low heat

title: Basic Crew Neck Cotton T-Shirt, Pack of 2
description:
Two everyday crew neck tees in soft combed cotton with a classic regular fit, for layering or wearing on their own.
• Material: 100% combed cotton jersey, 160 g/m²
• Ribbed crew neckline and short sleeves
• Pack contains 2 T-shirts in the same colour
• Pre-shrunk; machine wash at 40°C

title: Oversized Drop Shoulder T-Shirt in Heavyweight Cotton
description:
A boxy, slouchy tee with dropped shoulders and a thick, structured feel, made to be worn loose with jeans, cycling shorts or skirts.
• Material: 100% cotton, heavyweight 220 g/m² jersey
• Wide ribbed neckline and elbow-length sleeves
• Oversized fit: order your usual size for a roomy look
• Colours: white, pink and charcoal

title: Chunky Knit Crew Neck Sweater with Drop Shoulders
description:
A cosy, thick-knit jumper with a relaxed silhouette and dropped shoulders, for layering over shirts or wearing alone on cold days.
• Material: 60% acrylic, 30% polyester, 10% wool
• Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and hem
• Length approx. 62 cm in size M
• Hand wash cold or use a wool cycle; dry flat

title: V-Neck Button-Front Knit Cardigan
description:
A soft, mid-weight cardigan with a V-neck and button front that layers easily over dresses, tees and blouses.
• Material: 70% viscose, 30% nylon fine-gauge knit
• Five-button front with ribbed trims
• Regular fit, hip length, approx. 58 cm in size M
• Colours: mustard, grey and black
• Hand wash cold, dry flat

title: Oversized Fleece-Lined Pullover Hoodie with Kangaroo Pocket
description:
A roomy pullover hoodie with a brushed fleece lining that feels soft and warm, made for lazy weekends and chilly commutes.
• Material: 65% cotton, 35% polyester, 300 g/m² brushed fleece
• Lined hood with drawcords and a front kangaroo pocket
• Ribbed cuffs and hem; dropped shoulders
• Colours: pink, grey and black
• Machine wash at 30°C inside out

title: High Waist Straight Leg Jeans in Stretch Denim
description:
Everyday high-rise jeans with a straight leg and a touch of stretch for comfort that keeps its shape all day.
• Material: 98% cotton, 2% elastane, mid-blue wash
• High rise with zip fly and button fastening
• Classic five-pocket design
• Inside leg approx. 76 cm
• Machine wash at 30°C inside out

title: High Waist Wide Leg Trousers with Pleated Front
description:
Smart wide leg trousers with front pleats and a high waist that make an easy work outfit with a blouse or a fine knit.
• Material: 68% polyester, 28% viscose, 4% elastane
• Hook-and-bar closure with zip fly and belt loops
• Front slant pockets and back welt pockets
• Full length, approx. 104 cm outer leg in size M
• Machine wash at 30°C

title: Linen Blend Drawstring Wide Leg Pants
description:
Light, breathable pull-on trousers in a linen-cotton blend with a drawstring waist, made for summer holidays and warm days in the city.
• Material: 55% linen, 45% cotton
• Elasticated waist with an adjustable drawstring
• Two side pockets and a relaxed wide leg
• Colours: mustard and sage
• Machine wash at 30°C; iron while slightly damp

title: Polka Dot Midi Skirt with Elastic Waist
description:
A flowing A-line midi skirt with a playful polka dot print and a comfortable elasticated waistband. Pair it with a plain tee and trainers for an easy summer look.
• Material: 100% polyester crepe with a half lining
• Wide elasticated waistband, no fastening needed
• Length approx. 78 cm
• Colours: red with white dots, black with white dots
• Machine wash cold, hang to dry

title: High Waist Denim Shorts with Frayed Hem
description:
Classic high-rise denim shorts with a raw, frayed hem and a relaxed fit through the leg for sunny days.
• Material: 100% cotton rigid denim, light-blue wash
• Zip fly with button fastening and belt loops
• Five-pocket styling; inseam approx. 8 cm
• Machine wash at 30°C inside out

title: Double-Breasted Belted Trench Coat, Water-Repellent
description:
A timeless double-breasted trench coat with a water-repellent finish and a removable belt, ready for showers and changeable spring and autumn weather.
• Shell: 65% polyester, 35% cotton with water-repellent coating; lining: 100% polyester
• Notched lapels, shoulder epaulettes and buttoned cuff straps
• Two front pockets and a back vent
• Length approx. 100 cm in size M
• Colours: black and camel

title: Floral Print Wide Leg Jumpsuit with Tie Waist
description:
A one-piece outfit sorted in seconds: a sleeveless wide leg jumpsuit in a bold floral print with a tie belt to define the waist.
• Material: 100% viscose, soft and breathable
• V-neckline with wide straps and a concealed back zip
• Side pockets and a removable self-tie belt
• Full length, approx. 140 cm in size M
• Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle

title: Seamless Racerback Sports Bra with Removable Pads
description:
A seamless, medium-support sports bra with a racerback that stays comfortable through yoga, gym sessions and runs.
• Material: 88% nylon, 12% elastane, quick-drying knit
• Wide elastic under-band and racerback straps
• Removable pads for shape and coverage
• Pull-on design with no hooks
• Colours: green, pink and black

title: High Waist Yoga Leggings with Side Pockets
description:
Soft, opaque leggings with a high, wide waistband that stays in place through stretches, workouts and everyday wear. Two side pockets hold a phone or keys.
• Material: 75% nylon, 25% elastane with four-way stretch
• Double-layer high-rise waistband with a hidden key pocket
• Two deep side pockets and flatlock seams
• Full-length leg
• Machine wash at 30°C, do not tumble dry

title: Floral Triangle Bikini Set with Tie-Side Bottoms
description:
A two-piece bikini in a bright floral print, with a padded triangle top and tie-side bottoms you can adjust for the perfect fit.
• Material: 82% polyamide, 18% elastane, fully lined
• Top: removable padding, halter neck and back ties
• Bottoms: classic coverage with side ties
• Set includes top and bottoms
• Rinse in cool water after swimming; hand wash
